mapper.insert: INSERT INTO position_scan_evidence (tenant_id, run_id, node_id, source_position_id, expected_barcode, scanned_barcode, observed_at, scan_id, transfer_id, command_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{runId}, #{nodeId}, #{sourcePositionId}, #{expectedBarcode}, #{scannedBarcode}, CAST(#{observedAt} AS timestamptz), #{scanId}, #{transferId}, #{commandId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, scan_id) DO NOTHING
